info.name: Referencing Subject API
info.description:
Here you can find the Public API information of the Goodlord Referencing product. This API will allow you to create rental applications, assess Applicants and Guarantors through the rental process and manage them along the way.

Contact Support:
 Name: Goodlord
 Email: devs@vouch.co.uk
